1. The waggle dance explained

    Forager bees perform a waggle dance; the angle of the run shows the direction of food relative to the sun and its length shows the distance.

  2. Karl von Frisch and the bee language

    Karl von Frisch decoded the waggle dance in the 1940s and shared the 1973 Nobel Prize for it.

  3. How bees measure distance

    Bees judge distance by optic flow, so the dance reports how much the landscape moved past them.
